title: Committed same-task local rework lacks a lifespan-owned Factory stage driver

original_symptom.live_process: A durable completion action can reopen the exact TaskRuntime row and the still-running HTTP Router task can re-enter Director and QA.
original_symptom.after_restart: The cursor and TaskRuntime row recover, but no production lifespan worker consumes the reopened row without a new HTTP-owned run task.

root_cause.false_progress_risk: Treating pending_exec or a committed action receipt as progress without a durable driver claim

closed_subproblems: TaskRuntime exact numeric row reopen is idempotent and owner-bound
Factory advances convergence after Director failure and quality-gate fact commit
legacy TaskMarket and stage-metadata terminal-drain projections are rejected
Factory run task lifetime is backend-lifespan-owned and startup recovery includes pending exact-row actions
Backend process restart replays and closes the old physical-attempt epoch before opening a newer fenced execution epoch
implemented_fix: Factory stage-loop task lifecycle moved out of direct HTTP Router scheduling into a backend lifespan-owned platform service.
Persist a driver claim bound to workspace, Factory run, completion contract, action, diagnostic, owner task, and TaskRuntime execution anchor.
Recover committed unconsumed claims at backend startup without HTTP polling or a new client request.
Run only the owning Director task and affected verifier; do not restart PM or Chief Engineer.
Existing Factory stage claim and physical effect receipts remain the execution fence across crashes.
Strict restart replay does not resurrect an ambiguous provider attempt; resume_recovered_run creates a new coordinator under a higher workspace fencing token.
required_tests: action commit then backend crash then restart automatically resumes exact owner task
crash before effect and crash after effect both produce at most one physical effect
forged or cross-run driver claims fail closed
no Router request is required after restart
stop_conditions: Do not count a bare pending TaskRuntime row as progress.
Do not add another process-local queue, TaskMarket bridge, timer poller, or Bench-owned worker.
Do not claim unattended completion before restart recovery and fresh isolated COMPLETED_VERIFIED evidence.
